coverage.gr_equiv: none (no stock GR Hamming(7,4); golden = standard syndrome decoder, Hamming 1950 / Lin & Costello §3.3)
coverage.convention: c = d3 d2 d1 d0 p2 p1 p0 MSB-first; p2=d3^d2^d1, p1=d3^d2^d0, p0=d3^d1^d0 (pinned, shared with HammingEncoderBlock)
coverage.edge: all 16 clean codewords; 7:4 burst framing; trailing partial dropped; input LSB masked
coverage.exhaustive: 112/112 single-bit errors corrected ON-CHIP; all 128 7-bit words block-ref == golden
coverage.round_trip: golden-encoder -> DUT under 0 and 1 injected errors == identity
coverage.known_limit: double-bit errors uncorrectable (distance 3): all 16*21 patterns mis-decode (gated), DUT == golden's deterministic miscorrection on-chip
coverage.mutation: no-correction passthrough / wrong syndrome LUT / swapped bit order / +1 shift / empty / misframed stream
coverage.decision: rate 7:4, raw 0/1 words, BIT-EXACT, delay 0, tol 0
coverage.note: 2-cell pipeline: fused pack+syndrome accumulator (pre-shifted H columns) -> 8-entry LUT correct + MSB-first 4-bit burst
